name: iNext Woo Pincode Checker
author: Imdad Next Web

sections.description:
Woo Pincode Checker is a lightweight yet powerful WooCommerce plugin that allows customers to instantly check delivery availability by entering their PIN code, ZIP code or postal code before placing an order.

Unlike many delivery checker plugins, Woo Pincode Checker works directly with WooCommerce Shipping Zones, meaning you don’t need to maintain separate CSV files, Excel sheets or additional postcode databases. Simply configure your WooCommerce shipping zones and the plugin automatically validates customer delivery locations using AJAX without refreshing the page.

Whether you run a grocery store, pharmacy, restaurant, fashion shop, electronics store or any WooCommerce business offering local or regional delivery, Woo Pincode Checker helps customers know whether delivery is available before they add products to their cart.

This improves user experience, reduces unnecessary cart abandonment and minimizes customer support requests.

Why Choose Woo Pincode Checker?

  • Works directly with WooCommerce Shipping Zones
  • No CSV import required
  • No Excel upload required
  • No separate postcode database
  • Lightning-fast AJAX validation
  • Beginner friendly
  • Lightweight and optimized
  • Translation ready
  • WordPress Coding Standards compliant
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes

Supported Delivery Rules

Woo Pincode Checker supports all WooCommerce postcode formats.

  • Exact PIN Code 781021
  • Range 781001…781050
  • Wildcard 7812*
  • Multiple PIN Codes 781001…781050,7812*,781099

No matter how you configure WooCommerce Shipping Zones, Woo Pincode Checker understands and validates them automatically.

If you need assistance, please visit our support forum:

https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/inext-woo-pincode-checker/

  • Configurable postcode length
  • Support safe HTML tags in message fields
  • Numeric postcode support

  • Optional Add to Cart button restriction
  • Translation ready
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Clean and modern admin interface
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes
  • Regularly maintained
  • Theme Appearance mode
  • Modern Appearance mode
  • Live frontend preview in admin

  • Live delivery availability checking
  • Keyboard Enter key support

  • Responsive frontend design

How It Works

Woo Pincode Checker works directly with WooCommerce Shipping Zones, so there is no separate database to maintain.

  2. Install and activate Woo Pincode Checker.
  3. Create one or more Shipping Zones in WooCommerce.

  5. Enable the checker for Product, Cart or Checkout pages.
  6. Customers enter their postcode and instantly see whether delivery is available.
  7. If enabled, the Add to Cart button can remain disabled until a valid delivery postcode is entered.

sections.installation:
Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or later
  • WooCommerce
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Installation

  1. Upload the iNext Woo Pincode Checker plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to Woo Pincode Checker → Settings.
  5. Enable the plugin.
  6. Configure where you want to display the delivery checker:
    • Product Page
    • Cart Page
    • Checkout Page
    • Shortcode
  7. Configure your messages, labels and placeholders.
  8. Create or edit your WooCommerce Shipping Zones.
  9. Add the delivery PIN codes, ZIP codes or postal codes inside the Shipping Zone.
  10. Save your settings.

That’s it! Your customers can now instantly check delivery availability.

Shortcode

Display the delivery checker anywhere on your website.

`

[inext_wpc]
`

The shortcode can be used in:

  • Pages
  • Posts
  • Elementor
  • Gutenberg
  • Divi
  • Beaver Builder
  • WPBakery
  • Widgets
sections.faq:
Do I need to import a CSV or Excel file containing PIN codes?

No.

Woo Pincode Checker works directly with WooCommerce Shipping Zones, so there is no need to import CSV files, Excel sheets or maintain a separate postcode database.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce Shipping Zones?

Yes.

Woo Pincode Checker works directly with WooCommerce Shipping Zones.

Which WordPress themes are supported?

Woo Pincode Checker has been tested with many popular themes including Blocksy, Hello Elementor, Kadence, Astra, GeneratePress, Neve, OceanWP, Storefront, Botiga, Woostify, Sydney, ColorMag and the latest default WordPress themes.

It is designed to work with almost any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Can the checker match my website theme?

Yes.

Choose Theme Appearance mode to inherit your active theme’s typography and styling, or Modern Appearance mode for a clean standalone design.

Which postcode formats are supported?

The plugin supports:

  • Exact PIN codes
  • ZIP codes
  • Postal codes
  • Range matching
  • Wildcard matching
  • Multiple postcode matching
  • Mixed postcode rules

Does it support international postal codes?

Yes.

The plugin supports both numeric and alphanumeric postal codes.

Can I display the checker on the Product page?

Yes.

You can enable or disable it from the plugin settings.

Can I display it on the Cart page?

Yes.

Simply enable Cart support in the General Settings.

Can I display it on the Checkout page?

Yes.

Enable Checkout support from the plugin settings.

Can I use the checker anywhere on my website?

Yes.

Use the shortcode:

`

[inext_wpc]
`

on any page, post or page builder.

Can I change the button text?

Yes.

The button text can be customized from the Message Settings page.

Can I change the placeholder text?

Yes.

The placeholder, label and all customer-facing messages are fully customizable.

Can I change the validation messages?

Yes.

You can customize:

  • Success message
  • Delivery unavailable message
  • Invalid postcode message
  • Minimum length message
  • Maximum length message

Can I use HTML in delivery messages?

Yes. Message fields support safe HTML tags such as , ,
and . This allows you to create rich, formatted delivery messages while keeping your site secure.

Can I hide the Add to Cart button until a valid PIN code is entered?

Yes.

The plugin includes an option to disable the Add to Cart button until the entered delivery postcode is valid.

Is the plugin AJAX based?

Yes.

Customers receive instant delivery availability results without refreshing the page.

Does the plugin slow down my website?

No.

Woo Pincode Checker is lightweight and optimized for WooCommerce.

Is it compatible with Elementor?

Yes.

It works with Elementor and any builder that supports shortcodes.

Does it work with Divi?

Yes.

Does it work with popular WooCommerce themes?

Yes.

Woo Pincode Checker is compatible with most modern WordPress and WooCommerce themes.

See the Compatible Themes section above for the complete tested list.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes.

The plugin follows WordPress internationalization standards and is translation ready.

Where can I get support?

Please visit the official support forum:

https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/inext-woo-pincode-checker/

or visit:

https://plugins.imdadnextweb.com

screenshots.caption: Welcome > Dashboard - Beautiful welcome dashboard introducing the plugin with documentation, quick links, version information, and easy access to configuration settings.
Welcome > Overview - View plugin status, WooCommerce integration, shipping zone statistics, shortcode information, system details, and quick actions from one place.
Welcome > Features - Discover the key features including AJAX validation, Exact, Range, Wildcard, Multiple and Mixed postcode support, multilingual compatibility, and WooCommerce integration.
Welcome > Supported Pincode - Learn all supported WooCommerce postcode formats including Exact, Range, Wildcard, Multiple and Mixed shipping rules with practical examples.
Settings > Plugin Settings - Enable or disable the delivery checker and choose where it appears, including the Product page, Cart page and Checkout page.
Settings > Validation Settings - Configure postcode validation options including alphanumeric support, automatic customer postcode detection and custom postcode length.
Settings > Display Settings - Choose the frontend appearance mode, control label visibility, placeholder text and configure how the delivery checker is displayed.
Settings > Input Messages - Customize the input label, placeholder and button text with an instant live preview before publishing changes.
Settings > Response Messages - Customize delivery available, unavailable, blank and not found messages with live preview support.
Settings > Validation Messages - Configure validation messages for invalid, minimum and maximum postcode length using dynamic variables like {length}.
Theme Appearance > Auto - Automatically inherits the active WordPress or WooCommerce theme styles, ensuring the delivery checker blends seamlessly with your website design.
Theme Appearance > Modern - Modern responsive frontend design with clean styling, smooth interactions and compatibility across all popular WordPress themes.
Delivery Availability > Response Messages - Customers can instantly verify delivery availability using AJAX and receive clear success or error messages without reloading the page.
